maya (SDK): Hi team — quick sync: my SDK PR #438 changes auth header shape (adds x-rdwd-org). It's ready for review but blocked on API contract confirmation.
ryan (API): saw it, thanks. I'm on PTO this afternoon, but I can review by EOD. Is there a swagger diff?
maya (SDK): yup, here's the snippet: ```diff
- Authorization: Bearer <token>
+ X-Rdwd-Org: <org-id>
  Authorization: Bearer <token>
``` Need to know if console/back-end will accept both temporarily.
sophia (Console): Console can fast-follow but we have a feature flag gating auth path. If API keeps backward compat for one week we can roll console change in next sprint.
zach (Runtime): Helm chart needs a new env var RDWD_ORG_HEADER for sidecars. I can cut a patch but need approval from infra-owner.
maya (SDK): CI bot says SDK tests pass. @ryan any breaking concerns?
ryan (API): no functional break if header optional. Please add test for dual-header acceptance. Also add schema in openapi: `x-rdwd-org: string?`
maya (SDK): will add test. ETA ~2h.
sophia (Console): tagging @tim-infra for the helm/env var and @emily-sre for rollout window.
tim-infra: can do env var patch, prefer to merge during a low-traffic slot tomorrow 03:00 UTC.
emily-sre: confirm low-traffic window ok, set deploy freeze? we prefer canary + wait 30m.
maya (SDK): ok plan: 1) add dual-header test + openapi update; 2) Ryan reviews; 3) merge SDK; 4) Tim patches helm and runtime; 5) Sophia schedules console PR behind feature flag; 6) Emily runs canary. Anyone object?
ryan (API): lgtm assuming tests cover both headers.
tim-infra: i'll open helm PR and tag owners.
sophia (Console): adding checklist in PR description for feature flag toggle.
ci-bot: Deploy pipeline will run once all approvals present.
maya (SDK): thanks all — I'll post links when PRs ready.
ryan (API): ping me when tests pushed.
maya (SDK): pushed tests, PR: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/438 — @ryan @sophia please review.
ryan (API): reviewing now.
(edited) maya (SDK): added note about migration window in PR description :calendar:
